stories.title: Caccia Nato abbatte drone su Lituania. Trump: "Mosca e Kiev non attaccheranno obiettivi energetici"

en.title: NATO fighter shoots down drone over Lithuania. Trump: "Moscow and Kyiv will not attack energy targets"
en.summary: A NATO fighter downed a drone over Lithuanian airspace while Trump stated both Russia and Ukraine would not target energy infrastructure. Ukrainian President Zelensky called for guarantees, and German politician Merz warned that European peace is at risk.

stories.title: Caccia della Nato abbattono un drone sopra la Lituania "Difenderemo il nostro spazio aereo"

en.title: NATO fighters shoot down drone above Lithuania "We will defend our airspace"
en.summary: Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia regularly experience drone intrusions over their territories as NATO vows to protect its airspace in the region.

stories.title: Netanyahu contro Naza, il documentario sulle stragi di civili a Gaza: "Incita all'antisemitismo"

en.title: Netanyahu against Nazi documentary on Gaza civilian massacres: "Incites antisemitism"
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline closure pushed oil toward 110 dollars per barrel. A tanker was damaged by a mine at Hormuz, and Houthi attacks on Saudi cities wounded 13 people.

stories.title: Caccia della Nato abbattono un drone sopra la Lituania

en.title: NATO fighters shoot down drone above Lithuania
en.summary: Lithuanian President Nauseda stated that Russia is intensifying its aggression against Ukraine as NATO shot down a drone over Lithuanian airspace.

stories.title: Israele contro i registi di “Naza”. Netanyahu: “Sono antisemiti”. E l’Idf li mette sotto inchiesta

en.title: Israel against directors of "Naza". Netanyahu: "They are antisemitic". And the IDF launches an investigation into them
en.summary: Israeli officials have criticized the filmmakers behind a documentary depicting harsh methods used in Gaza, with Netanyahu accusing them of antisemitism and the military investigating them.

stories.title: Caro carburanti, Trump: "Colpa della guerra in Ucraina, non della crisi nel Golfo"

en.title: Fuel prices, Trump: "It's Ukraine war's fault, not the Gulf crisis"
en.summary: Trump attributed high fuel prices to the Ukraine conflict rather than regional instability, mentioning discussions about protecting energy infrastructure while dismissing artificial intelligence risks.

stories.title: Patto tra Scozia, Galles e Irlanda del Nord: “Decidiamo noi il nostro futuro”

en.title: Pact between Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland: "We decide our own future"
en.summary: Three of the four UK nations met in Cardiff to pursue independence from the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. Il presidente lituano: “Drone abbattuto nel nostro spazio aereo da caccia Nato”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news today. Lithuanian president: "Drone shot down in our airspace by NATO fighter"
en.summary: Lithuania's president reported that a drone was detected and shot down in the country's airspace near Vilnius by a NATO fighter jet.

stories.title: Trump: stop ai raid sulle raffinerie, sì di Kiev e Mosca. Zelensky: Putin non rispetterà accordi

en.title: Trump: stop raids on refineries, yes from Kyiv and Moscow. Zelensky: Putin will not respect agreements
en.summary: Ukraine's leader indicated willingness to suspend attacks if Russia does the same, while expressing skepticism about Putin honoring any potential agreement on stopping refinery attacks.

stories.title: Trump annuncia la tregua degli obiettivi energetici tra Mosca e Kiev. Zelensky: “La rispettiamo”

en.title: Trump announces truce on energy targets between Moscow and Kyiv. Zelensky: "We respect it"
en.summary: Ukraine's president indicated willingness to pursue an agreement under certain conditions while expressing doubt about Russia's commitment to honoring any accord on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Netanyahu contro Naza, 'intollerabile incitare all'antisemitismo dall'interno'

en.title: Netanyahu against Nazi, 'intolerable to incite antisemitism from within'
en.summary: Israel's Prime Minister responded to reports of Nazi-related antisemitic incitement, describing the situation as disturbing.

stories.title: Crolla un albero in piazza Risorgimento a Milano: feriti tre passanti, uno è grave. «Segnalato più volte, eravamo terrorizzati»

en.title: Tree falls in Piazza Risorgimento in Milan: three pedestrians injured, one seriously. 'Reported multiple times, we were terrified'
en.summary: A tree collapsed in a Milan square, injuring three pedestrians including one seriously, with residents reporting they had previously flagged concerns about the tree.

stories.title: Tasca, vino di alta fascia e spinta all’export nella nuova strategia

en.title: Tasca, high-end wine and export push in new strategy
en.summary: Tasca d'Almerita is returning to its founder's original vision and philosophy to enhance the company's prestige and expand export opportunities.

stories.title: Buste paga, il welfare diventa il miglior alleato contro il carovita

en.title: Paychecks, welfare becomes the best ally against cost of living
en.summary: A majority of workers view welfare benefits as important and helpful for managing daily expenses, with half preferring to receive bonuses as credits.

stories.title: Arredo, made in Italy solido ma in ritardo sulle tecnologie digitali

en.title: Furniture, solid made in Italy but lagging in digital technologies
en.summary: A Bip survey identifies a potential global furniture market worth 940 billion euros by 2030, highlighting digital technology challenges for Italian companies.

stories.title: Milano, una piattaforma digitale per connettere fiere e territorio

en.title: Milan, a digital platform to connect fairs and territory
en.summary: My Fair Plus, a new digital platform promoted by the Milan Fair Foundation in collaboration with major cultural institutions in the city, has been launched to connect trade fairs with the local area.

stories.title: Bolognafiere, nuove partnership per crescere su moda, pet e vino

en.title: Bolognafiere, new partnerships to grow in fashion, pet and wine sectors
en.summary: Bolognafiere has formed a partnership with White Milano for international events and expanded its pet industry offerings in India and Turkey.
